title: 数据血缘：上游传递闭包与下游影响面
code:
# 数据血缘：从表级依赖反推上游闭包与下游影响面
LINEAGE = {
    "ods_order_log":      [],
    "ods_user_log":       [],
    "dwd_order_detail":   ["ods_order_log"],
    "dwd_user_info":      ["ods_user_log"],
    "dwd_user_log":       ["ods_user_log"],
    "dws_trade_user_1d":  ["dwd_order_detail", "dwd_user_info"],
    "dws_user_active_1d": ["dwd_user_log"],
    "ads_gmv_overview":   ["dws_trade_user_1d"],
    "ads_kpi_wide":       ["dws_trade_user_1d", "dws_user_active_1d"],
}


def ancestors(target):
    """上游传递闭包（含自身以外）。"""
    out, stack = set(), [target]
    while stack:
        cur = stack.pop()
        for up in LINEAGE.get(cur, []):
            if up not in out:
                out.add(up)
                stack.append(up)
    return out


def descendants(source):
    """下游传递闭包（含自身以外）。"""
    out, stack = set(), [source]
    while stack:
        cur = stack.pop()
        for tbl, ups in sorted(LINEAGE.items()):
            if cur in ups and tbl not in out:
                out.add(tbl)
                stack.append(tbl)
    return out


def paths(src, dst):
    """枚举 src -> dst 的全部血缘路径。"""
    res = []

    def dfs(cur, acc):
        if cur == dst:
            res.append(list(reversed(acc)))
            return
        for nxt in sorted(n for t, u in LINEAGE.items() if cur in u for n in (t,)):
            dfs(nxt, [nxt] + acc)

    dfs(src, [src])
    return res


print("== 表级血缘图（每行：表 <- 直接上游） ==")
for t in sorted(LINEAGE):
    print("  " + t.ljust(20) + " <- " + (", ".join(LINEAGE[t]) or "(数据源)"))

print("")
print("== 用例 A：ads_kpi_wide 的上游血缘（回答『这张表的数据从哪来』） ==")
up = ancestors("ads_kpi_wide")
for level_tip, pred in (("ODS 层", lambda x: x.startswith("ods_")),
                        ("DWD 层", lambda x: x.startswith("dwd_")),
                        ("DWS 层", lambda x: x.startswith("dws_"))):
    hit = sorted(x for x in up if pred(x))
    print("  " + level_tip + ": " + str(hit))
print("  上游传递闭包节点数 = " + str(len(up)))
print("  完整上游清单 = " + str(sorted(up)))

print("")
print("== 用例 B：ods_user_log 的下游影响面（回答『改它会影响谁』） ==")
down = descendants("ods_user_log")
print("  直接影响（一度下游） = " + str(sorted(t for t, u in LINEAGE.items()
                                          if "ods_user_log" in u)))
print("  下游传递闭包 = " + str(sorted(down)))
print("  下游受影响表数 = " + str(len(down)))
print("  其中 ADS 应用表 = " + str(sorted(t for t in down if t.startswith("ads_"))))

print("")
print("== 血缘路径枚举 ==")
p = paths("ods_user_log", "ads_kpi_wide")
print("  ods_user_log -> ads_kpi_wide 的路径数 = " + str(len(p)))
for one in p:
    print("    " + " -> ".join(one))

print("")
print("判据 1（ads_kpi_wide 上游闭包覆盖 7 张源表）: " + str(len(up) == 7))
print("判据 2（ods_user_log 的下游影响面包含 2 张 ADS 表）: " +
      str(len([t for t in down if t.startswith("ads_")]) == 2))
print("判据 3（血缘路径枚举数 = 2）: " + str(len(p) == 2))
print("判据 4（ods_order_log 与 ads_kpi_wide 存在血缘连通）: " +
      str("ads_kpi_wide" in descendants("ods_order_log")))
